milestones.name: Open City of Tears west gate
milestones.note: Use City Crest on statue of Great Knight Hegemol in Fungal Wastes to open the west main gate

milestones.name: Save Zote in Greenpath
milestones.note: Knight can choose to save Zote from a Vengefly King; if not saved before acquiring Mantis Claw, Zote dies

milestones.name: Save Zote in Deepnest
milestones.note: Knight can choose to save Zote from spider webs; leaving him does not result in death

milestones.name: Defeat Zote at Colosseum of Fools
milestones.note: Final boss of the first trial; deals no damage; grants Rivalry achievement

milestones.name: Acquire City Crest
milestones.note: Required to open the west main gate of City of Tears from Fungal Wastes

milestones.name: Acquire Tram Pass
milestones.note: Used to reach Ancient Basin, then up to east City of Tears

milestones.name: Acquire Mantis Claw
milestones.note: Required to access City of Tears from Royal Waterways central part

milestones.name: Acquire Love Key
milestones.note: Covered in padding, bears a symbol of love; unlocks door of Tower of Love

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.fingerprintHint: Rainy capital of Hallownest; water leaks from Blue Lake through ceiling; Infected

zones.name: Fungal Wastes
zones.fingerprintHint: West neighbor of City of Tears; contains west main gate statue of Great Knight Hegemol

zones.name: Ancient Basin
zones.fingerprintHint: Accessible via Tram Pass; leads up to east City of Tears

zones.name: Royal Waterways
zones.fingerprintHint: Central section leads up into City of Tears; requires Mantis Claw

zones.name: Kingdom's Edge
zones.fingerprintHint: Reachable by Tram; has access point to King's Station on its west side

zones.name: King's Station
zones.fingerprintHint: Part of City of Tears; accessible from Kingdom's Edge west side

zones.name: Resting Grounds
zones.fingerprintHint: Contains a lift leading to east part of City of Tears

zones.name: Greenpath
zones.fingerprintHint: Location where Zote is first found trapped by a Vengefly King

zones.name: Dirtmouth
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote appears here after being saved in Greenpath

zones.name: Deepnest
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote found stuck in spider webs here

zones.name: Colosseum of Fools
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote is final boss of first trial here if saved both times; has resting area

abilities.name: City Crest
abilities.grants: Opens west main gate of City of Tears
abilities.note: Used on statue of Great Knight Hegemol

abilities.name: Tram Pass
abilities.grants: Allows use of Tram to reach Ancient Basin and Kingdom's Edge

abilities.name: Mantis Claw
abilities.grants: Required to access City of Tears from Royal Waterways central part

abilities.name: Love Key
abilities.grants: Unlocks door of Tower of Love
abilities.note: Covered in padding, bears a symbol of love

bosses.name: Vengefly King
bosses.note: Holds Zote in its mandibles; Knight can choose to save Zote or leave him

bosses.name: Zote
bosses.note: Final boss of first trial; deals no damage due to shellwood nail; beating him grants Rivalry achievement
